actual_tools: European Nucleotide Archive DRR037765 and local Python standard library
execution.implementation: Genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation plus deterministic FASTQ metrics from the first 500 complete records of a retained public ENA object

observations: The retained source is the 127,526-byte ENA DRR037765 gzip object with the recorded MD5.
The deterministic 500-read subset contains 235,490 bases, 28.846236 percent GC, and 95.397681 percent Q30.
All 471 per-cycle summaries are retained in a machine-readable CSV.
A genuine Rosalind Workbench open call returned the exact task-chooser-ready message.
interpretation: The subset has high aggregate Q30 while showing a localized per-cycle quality dip that merits full-run review before downstream use.
limitations: The 500-read prefix does not represent the full-run distribution.
No adapter, contamination, duplication, or assay-specific review was performed.
rosalind_open only opened the task chooser and did not run FASTQ QC.

provenance.note: The retained ENA object and local script support the QC metrics; the separate 894-byte Rosalind observation supports launcher readiness only.

reproduction: Run python showcases/rosalind-workbench/cases/rosalind-fastq-qc/build_case.py from the repository root.
Require the recorded compressed MD5, 500 valid records, 235,490 bases, and the canonical subset SHA-256.
Treat the Rosalind launcher receipt separately from the FASTQ computation.
